summary: Add a tenant-scoped grounded operator assistant with bounded evidence, safe recommendations and non-executing action previews over canonical commerce sources.

impacts.evidence: Sessions, runs, feedback and source retrieval require authenticated organization/workspace scope and actor ownership.
Raw prompts, provider payloads, chain-of-thought, credentials and unnecessary PII are excluded from persistence and events.
Assistant session/run/feedback routes are additive under /api/v1 and generated SDKs are refreshed.
Versioned assistant lifecycle and preview payload schemas are listed in the canonical event catalog.
The assistant consumes provider-neutral capability/source contracts and does not add a privileged connector path.
Migration 38 adds bounded tenant tables with composite keys, indexes and FORCE RLS.
Server-side classification, secret/injection refusal, safe rendering, permission checks and no direct provider access are enforced.
Allowlisted previews carry risk and approval metadata; execution remains in existing approval/domain APIs.
Run completion audit stores only intent, state and context/answer digests; source evidence remains linked by digest.
Run identity is derived from idempotency and actor/session scope; versioned cancellation prevents duplicate side effects.
Provider egress remains governed by existing AI policy; assistant retrieval itself performs no remote IO for GET.
Lifecycle states, bounded leases, retry classification and grounding coverage provide operational signals.
Assistant tables and UI are additive; deterministic baseline can be disabled without stopping commerce writes.
Core safety, API parity, worker transition, schema fixtures, migration, SDK and frontend checks cover the slice.
